_comment: plan-quests.md C4, quest 2 of 4 — the harvest verb. D2: harvest-N is kill-N of a harvest species, so this rides the same lifetime counters as a wolf cull; the Turnip is damageable ONLY by a `harvest`-tagged aura, which is the one the Farmer teaches in the same conversation. Six turnips stand in the row north of him and respawn on 600 ticks, so five is a chore rather than a wait. Reward: 150 XP. Text deliberately plain (PO 2026-08-02: no lore or stylized quest text yet — simple, direct wording only).
